scope: Phases 0-7: retained-detail adaptive economy, independent administration, sites/commuting/freight, representative inspection and global optional LLM policy. Causal individuals and US benchmark repairs are deferred.

interpretation.conservation: Physical/financial and cohort accounting; does not imply economic stability or historical accuracy.
interpretation.resolution: Exact retained market/household/firm closure. Numerical partitions change grouping, not nonlinear economic inputs. No averaged-coarse-agent convergence claim.
interpretation.longRunSource: Three complete 2400-month runs precede the late settlement isolation/depot fix. The settlement-corrected implementation separately replays months 2281-2400 with identical annual metrics for all three seeds and exact month-2401 compressed-save continuation. The final display-subscription change leaves canonical mechanics unchanged and is covered by exact projection and browser/headless comparison checks. Source hashes are explicit; these are not described as three fresh final-source 200-year reruns.
interpretation.performance: Concurrent qualification on Apple M4 Pro/24 GiB. Full-duration endurance and timing-budget compliance are reported independently.

The minimum-width setting is 125 m (128 m on the current power-of-two tree). These are declared numerical choices; camera position is absent. AMReX conservation and coarse–fine interfaces.

Municipalities and provinces periodically compare local mergers, splits and boundary transfers. Monthly cost combines travel time valued at one quarter of the hourly wage, office staffing and increasing administrative workload. A reform requires 36 months of expected savings to exceed its paid reorganization labor. Geometry must remain complete, connected and within one sovereign state. Permanent legal references and past national accounts survive the change. Initial boundary proposals use legacy terrain polygons; computational leaves can be much smaller.
